fieldValues.title: CrossFieldRule with unrecognized type value MUST be reported as a Type-level error; unknown types MUST NOT be silently ignored
fieldValues.normative_statement: A `CrossFieldRule` with a `type` value not in `["conditional-required", "conditional-forbidden", "field-ordering", "mutual-exclusion"]` MUST be reported as a Type-level validation error. Implementations MUST NOT silently ignore unknown rule types. (RFC-019 R9.)
